thread:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGERS — Elevated 5xx rate detected across control-plane endpoints (auth/org-lookup/billing). Error spike started ~1802104300, current 5xx ~18% (baseline ~0.2%). Alerts: wavefront/controlplane.urgent, logs show upstream timeouts to auth-service and billing-proxy.
Alex: ack, I'm oncall. Pulling up traces and logs now.
Priya: I'm nearby, can take dependency debugging if needed.
Sam: seeing lots of 504s from config-gateway -> auth-service in the last 3 minutes.
Maria: customer impact: increases in API errors for hosted customers — several support tickets coming in. Adding incident tag.
Alex: quick plan: 1) throttle noisy tenants at gateway 2) enable auth cache fallback for 10m 3) scale auth-service replicas 4) if no improvement, fail open auth for non-critical routes.
Priya: on logs: auth-service error stream shows repeated DB connection timeouts followed by retry storms. Billing-proxy shows rate-limited 429s then 5xx on retries. Looks like a dependency cascade.
Sam: running a quick query on wavefront dashboard: `ts(ts(ts(error.rate, 5m), by, service), sum)` returns spike concentrated in us-west-2 and dedicated-pool routes.
Alex: mitigation attempt 1: add a temporary rate-limit filter at control-gateway for POST /v1/orgs/* from platform-internal clients.
Maria: go for it, notify support that we're throttling to protect control plane (no config changes to customer data).
Taylor: pushing the following change to edge config (canary to 5% first):
```
# edge rate limit
route: /v1/orgs/*
match: method == POST
actions:
  - rate_limit: 300r/s per tenant
```
Incident Bot: Deploy started by Taylor. Canary -> 5% at 1802104380.
Alex: canary shows 30% reduction in errors on canary nodes within 60s. Applying to 100% now.
Priya: while that rolls, I'm enabling short-term auth token cache (TTL 30s) in auth-service to cut down org-lookup to DB. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/auth-service AUTH_CACHE_TTL=30s -n control`
Sam: executed `kubectl scale deploy/auth-service --replicas=6 -n control` to add capacity. Pods are coming up.
Maria: customer comms draft: "We're investigating increased control-plane errors affecting some API requests; mitigation in progress and impact limited to config changes and org operations. We'll update in 30 mins." Approving.
Alex: metrics: 5xx dropped from 18% -> 7% after global rate-limits and cache enable. DB error rate still elevated but trending down.
Priya: billing-proxy still returning internal 500s for some tenants due to a token validation loop. I'm putting a temporary feature-flag to skip billing-validation for non-billable metadata endpoints. Patching now.
Taylor: patch applied via rollout `ff-toggle billing-skip-nonbillable true` to control gateway.
Sam: traces look cleaner; tail latency for auth-service primaries improved. 5xx now ~2.5%.
Alex: good. Next steps: keep throttles and cache for 15m, monitor. Prepare handoff to next oncall at +30m with summary. If we hit <1% 5xx sustained, start unwinding temporary changes.
Priya: capturing root cause hypothesis: DB connection pool exhaustion from a surge of org-lookup retries triggered by a billing-proxy slow-down. We'll run a deeper postmortem and long-term fixes: connection pool tuning, circuit breakers on billing-proxy, and back-pressure in gateway.
Maria: raising an incident ticket to SOC and Customer Success for affected accounts list. Notifying top 5 customers on SLA.
Alex: oncall handoff in 20m to Taylor. Leaving runbook notes here: 
```
- Keep rate-limit active until 1802105100
- Keep AUTH_CACHE_TTL=30s until DB connections stable
- Billing skip flag active for non-billable endpoints
- Watch wavefront: controlplane.5xx, auth.response_time, billing.errors
- If 5xx > 5% re-escalate to paging
```
Taylor: acknowledged. I'll own the 20m watch and handle next steps.
Incident Bot: Pager cleared at 1802104720 (automated threshold). Final 5xx at clear: 1.1%.
Alex: closing loop for live mitigation. Will open postmortem and assign follow-ups: PRI-1 (DB pool fix), PRI-2 (circuit breaker), ENG-OBS (longer term telemetry for dependency latency).
Maria: filing customer followups and summarizing support threads.
Priya: logging snippets for postmortem: `auth-service: ERROR connection timeout to primary-db after 3 retries` repeated 1.2k times between 1802104300-1802104400.
Sam: saving debug trace link: https://wavefront.company/wf/trace/1802104321-controlplane-cascade
Taylor: handing off now to oncall rotation. Good work team. :thumbsup:
Alex: thumbs up, great mitigation. We'll circle tomorrow for RCA.
